segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin describe the toner as fragrance-free, non-irritating, and calming, with one reporting it healed irritation and breakouts caused by another product.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination, breakout-prone skin reports the toner keeps pores and oil in check without drying out the skin.
segments.oily: One reviewer reports feeling less oily throughout the day with daily use.

concerns.spots: Reviewers report the toner minimizes the appearance of pores; two specifically call it effective for tightening or shrinking pores.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with acne-prone, sensitive skin reports breakouts and irritation from another product cleared up after switching to this toner; another with combo, breakout-prone skin reports it helps keep breakouts in check.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports skin feels less red immediately after use.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer reports the toner helps with inner dryness when layered, and another notes it does not dry out the skin despite controlling oil.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports reduced shine/oiliness throughout the day; another notes it controls oil without stripping skin.

extraits.texte: I have acne-prone and sensitive skin, and I can actually see an improvement in my skin texture and smaller pores after using this product! Love the lightweight texture, and when I layer it, it feels like it really helps with inner dryness.

My skin always feels smoother and less red right after I use it. I have combo skin that breaks out easily, and this helps keep my pores and oil in check without drying me out. It's fragrance-free too, which I love.
